# Markdown Fixture

This is a **Markdown** document used for tests.

## Features

- Offline document embedding
- Semantic search over local files
- Multiple formats: PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX

| Format | Tool          |
|--------|---------------|
| PDF    | pdftotext     |
| DOCX   | pandoc        |
| XLSX   | libreoffice   |

Inline `code` and a [link](https://example.com) round out the test.
